hints.title: Creating a thread with a stop flag
hints.content: Declare `volatile boolean threadRunning = true;` as an instance variable. In the thread body, loop with `while (threadRunning)`. Set `threadRunning = false` to signal the thread to stop.

hints.title: AtomicInteger usage
hints.content: Declare `AtomicInteger counter = new AtomicInteger(0);`. In the background thread, call `counter.incrementAndGet()` to safely increment it. In the main thread, read it with `counter.get()`.

hints.title: Stopping a thread cleanly
hints.content: Set `threadRunning = false`, call `thread.interrupt()` to break any sleep, then call `thread.join()` to wait for it to fully finish before proceeding.
